capabilities: Aggregates updates from WeChat, YouTube, Bilibili, and RSS sources
Saves links, files, and transcripts to a local reading library
Picks daily reading shortlists and rotates older unread saves
Tracks reading state, progress, versions, and annotations
Hands material to Claudian or a Wiki workflow
extras: Interface is in Chinese. Local import, reading, and progress need no account, model, or service; network features need the separate service, and some feeds, search, and model services require an account or payment. Needs Obsidian desktop 1.13.0+; Node.js 22.13+ for the service and source builds.
motivation: The author built it because finding things took more effort than reading them, and app home screens with shorts and autoplay drained the attention set aside for an article or long video.
problem: Following creators across WeChat, video platforms, and feeds means constant app switching, and saved links lose reading progress, annotations, and source context.

relations.evidence: With a compatible version of Claudian enabled, click 交给 Claudian 处理 (Send to Claudian) in Guanlan.
RSSHub is used for the optional Bilibili route.

requires.name: separately run material service for subscriptions and web imports
Quyue or Dajiala for WeChat Official Account feeds

summary: Reading workbench that follows WeChat, YouTube, Bilibili, and RSS sources, saves articles and videos to a local library, and hands them to an AI agent.
